description: Hand the browser agent a goal in plain language and let it work. It knows the page, the session you are signed into, and what each form accepts. Prefer this over driving the browser yourself — you never need to see the page.

goal.description: What you want done, e.g. "search for a cordless drill under $80".

tabId.description: Tab to work in. Defaults to the active tab.

name: delegate_goal
title: Delegate a goal to the browser
